description: Search public gallery works by keyword across title, description, tags and id; omit query to browse the newest works. Returns a paginated result set (items, total, page, pages) where each item has id, title, views and URLs. sort is new (newest) or hot (most liked and viewed); limit is capped at 20. No auth required. Use view to open a result, or list_assets for your own uploads.

query.description: Keyword matched against title, description, tags and id; empty returns the newest works.

sort.description: new = newest first; hot = most liked and viewed.

name: search_gallery
